profile.subtitleJa: エフライムの山地ラマタイム・ツォフィムに住む人
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記上1:1は、エフライムの山地に住むエルカナを、ヨラハム、エリフ、トフ、ツフの子孫として紹介します。本文は彼をエフライム人と呼びます。

facts.textJa: エルカナは妻たちと子どもたちに、いけにえの分を配ります。
エルカナは悲しむハンナに声を掛け、慰めようとします。
家族はラマに戻り、その後エルカナとハンナの間に子が宿ります。
エルカナは誓願に伴う年ごとのいけにえをささげに家族とシロへ上ります。
ハンナはサムエルを乳離れさせるまで家にとどまり、エルカナはそれを認めます。
エリはエルカナと妻に祝福を告げます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;
Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”
They rose up in the morning early and worshiped the LORD, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.
The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may the LORD establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him.
Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served the LORD before Eli the priest.
Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May the LORD give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of the LORD.” Then they went to their own home.
